findings.source_quote: She had spent a week with her aunt and uncle who lived several counties over from hers
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the target-language phrase "’n paar dorpe verder" with a closer equivalent for "several counties over" such as "’n paar distrikte verder" or "’n paar provinsies verder", depending on intended administrative sense. Example fix: change "wat ’n paar dorpe verder van hulle af gewoon het" to "wat ’n paar distrikte verder van hulle af gewoon het".
